attribution.legal_posture: MSMT Annex 7 official multilateral reporting; named by an issuing government or multilateral sanctions-monitoring source; it is an official source summary. Criminal charge, conviction, sanctions designation, and adjudication require separate records; an independent source family requires a separate source. The source supplies no charging determination.

caveats: Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; alias ownership and worker identity remain source-unresolved.
KMCTC-wide methods or practices remain distinct from Kang Song Ho personally.
This is same-source depth from the already-admitted MSMT/2025/2 report; corroboration remains within the MSMT/2025/2 source family.
The already-represented employment alias, presented-country field, email/contact and account selectors, client/victim identities, passport/identity details, and precise locations are excluded.

The three person-specific Annex 7 rows support historical contract-target geography and listed/aggregate rate and workload metadata; duration and current or continuous employment require employment records.
